UGC360 Dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0)
Andy Regensky, Marc Windsheimer, Fabian Brand and André Kaup
Beyond Perspective: Neural 360-Degree Video Compression, ICCV 2025
https://huggingface.co/datasets/FAU-LMS/UGC360
Pinned dataset revision: 99f74d256df961695968f6f39d58e1b004ce0a59

Selected original videos are CC BY, CC BY-SA or CC0 according to the
per-clip UGC360 metadata. No ND or NC source was selected. The metadata
records licence families; it does not specify each original licence version.
Original video URLs, available creator names, source frame SHA-256 values,
publication dates and the dataset CSV are retained. Where current platform
metadata is unavailable, attribution uses the source link and all information
supplied by UGC360. Individual sources remain subject to their original licences.

Changes by Video32 / Shael Riley, 2026:
Nine consecutive source frames reduced to spherical studies. One 180-degree
hemisphere selected for visible content. Each local image patch is matched
against the unchanged 32 canonical 8x16 glyph masks; colors are RGB565.
Slow forward/reverse playback, viewing sweeps and musical geometric bending
are added. No audio, full-length movie or reconstructed depth is included.

The bundled image data, derived glyph fabrics and associated video metadata
are offered under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
This licence does not replace the separate MIT licence of the renderer code.
